title: Quenched Gourmet Polish Bacon Gratin
description: Savory Polish dish featuring bacon, bonito, and a glassy-jelly crust. Hangover-cure included, but not guaranteed.
instructions: Meanwhile, toast the dense Polish rye bread slices for 2-3 minutes on the grill, or until lightly browned and fragrant.
In a small skillet, cook the bacon lardons over medium heat until crispy and golden brown, about 8-10 minutes. Let cool completely on paper towels.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs and heavy cream until well combined.
Butter the toasted bread slices, then spoon the egg mixture over each slice, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the cooked bacon lardons, bonito flakes, salt, and black pepper over the egg mixture, dividing evenly among the bread slices.
Place the bread slices on the preheated raclette grill and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until the egg mixture is set and the bread is golden brown.
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the bread slices from the grill and transfer to a serving plate.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Serve immediately, and enjoy your hangover-cure Polish gratin!
